description: Historical number statistics for a game: hot and cold numbers, how often each number was drawn, or the most common pairs. Products include the South African games, "UK49s" (all four draws combined), "EuroMillions", "US Powerball", "Kenya Lotto" and "Gosloto 6/45". Unknown products are rejected without using a call. Uses 1 API call from your ResultsZA plan.
name: get_number_statistics
title: Get number statistics
